results: Random counts 1–10 replace all region/paragraph controls and survive navigation
Sequential quote batch locks editing/navigation, verifies all positions, and cannot repeat
Up to ten sequential divider insertions and independent sticker counts preserve quote results
Transfer uses content-aware boundaries and never separates headings from explanations

Stopping an in-flight batch ignores its late response and never dispatches the next insertion
